simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּנַס (H3664) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּנַס (kânaç) means to collect ; hence, to enfold First listed occurrence: 1Chr 22 2.

definitions.full: H3664. kanas [ כָּנַס ] verb gather, collect (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כְּנַס (see also כנשׁ ); Ethiopic in derived conjugation assemble for worship , etc.; Arabic is sweep, sweep away, destroy ) — Qal (late) Perfect 1singular כָּנַסְתִּי Eccl 2:8 ; Imperative כְּנוֺס Est 4:16 ; Infinitive construct 1Chr 22:2-3 t.; Participle כֹּנֵס Psa 33:7 ; — gather people 1Chr 22:2 ; Est 4:16 ; ׳כ תְּהוֺמוֺת בְּאוֺצָרוֺת נֹתֵן הַיָּ֑ם מֵי כַּנֵּד Psa 33:7 (read perhaps, for כַּנּאֹד כַּנֵּד, as in a wine skin , see נד נאד, ); gather, collect portions of harvest for priests and Levites Neh 12:44 ; stones Eccl 3:5 (opposed to השׁליך ); silver and gold = amass wealth 2:8 ; absolute 2:26 (|| אסף ). Pi`el Perfect 1singular אֶתְכֶם וְכִנַּסְתִּ֫י Ezek 22:21 and I will gather you together (for punishment; Co translates to 22:20 and reads for וְהִנַּחְתִּ֫י ; || קבץ 22:19 ; 22:20 ); of restoration אֶלאַֿדְמָתָם וְכִנַּסְתִּים 39:28 , and יְכַנֵּס Psa 147:2 . Hithpa`el Infinitive construct צָרָה כְּהִתְכַּנֵּסוְהַמַּסֵּכָה Isa 28:20 and the covering is (too) narrow when one gathers oneself together (|| הַמַּצָּע מֵהִשְׂתָּרֵעַקָצַר ), i.e. the bed is too short to stretch oneself at full length, and when one (perforce) draws up the feet, the covering becomes too narrow.
